commit_message_withheld_from_predictor: Remove all dwa code for flip detection. * This has didactic value, but it's not even twice as fast as rasterop   morphology.  On a 8 Mpixel image, rasterop is 0.37 sec, dwa is 0.21. * So the added complexity is not worth the cost, especially for this   single case application. * The dwa code, including that in fliphmtgen.c, has been put in a   new file: flipdetectdwa.c.notused; it is not compiled in the library. * Likewise, the file prog/flipselgen.c is renamed flipselgen.c.notused,   and is no longer compiled in. * prog/flipdetect_reg.c is now an actual regression test.
